metadata.priceBasis: Pinnacle: last pre-match plus archived snapshots
limitations: 2026 is a partial season. Coverage excludes missing prices, unresolved joins and incomplete scores.

Valuebetennis closing means the provider’s last recorded pre-match price; it can differ from the final market tick. Tennis-Data snapshots have no verified closing timestamp and are labelled separately.
OnCourt result agreement is not a guarantee of upstream source independence. Sackmann is a supplementary check and its local 2026 file ends during Roland Garros.
